query:
UPDATE sessions
                   SET current_mode = COALESCE(?, current_mode),
                       available_commands_json = COALESCE(?, available_commands_json),
                       config_options_json = COALESCE(?, config_options_json),
                       updated_at = MAX(updated_at, ?),
                       last_node_seq = MAX(last_node_seq, ?)
                 WHERE session_id = ?
